claim_short: Zero-shot, a pooled activation z is scored by its projection onto the unit contrast ... higher meaning more deceptive. The sign is fixed by construction, and no labels are used.
Trained, we fit an L2-regularised logistic regression (C = 0.1, standardised features, no intercept, matching the pipeline's own probe) on one of three feature sets
A probe on a single feature can learn only a sign and a scale. Whenever every training set agrees on the sign, its AUROC on a test set therefore equals the zero-shot AUROC
As a control, three random directions replace the persona components (five draws).
